title: Polynomial time for block output
statement: Let $\mathrm{out}$ be a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings. Define an output function on bit strings $s$ as follows: return the empty string if the first projection of $s$ is empty; otherwise return $\mathrm{out}(s)$ if the first projection of the second projection of $s$ is empty; in all other cases return the empty string. This function is polynomial-time computable.
